Captain Titus makes his Battle Report debut this week at the head of a mighty force of Ultramarines – how will they fare against the sorcerous Thousand Sons? Plus, learn all about the macabre science behind servo-skulls and servitors in Weapons and Wargear, and make Asdrubael Vect proud with a Kabal of the Black Heart painting masterclass!
